collar_tag_req: Every dog owner must ensure that the dog tag is securely fixed on the animal for the purpose of identification.
dog_limit: No person shall keep more than three (3) dogs on any property unless operating a licensed kennel. The bylaw establishes a 'Personal Use Kennel' category that permits keeping more than three dogs for predator control.
notes: URL: https://chatsworth.ca/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/2019-32-Animal-Control-By-law-Dogs-and-Kennels-amended-BL-2020-76.pdf. While the bylaw lacks a distinct LGD definition, it is farm-friendly because its 'Personal Use Kennel' provisions explicitly permit properties to keep more than 3 dogs specifically for the purpose of 'predator control'.

dog_limit: The bylaw defines a kennel as a building or structure where more than 3 dogs are kept, meaning a maximum of 3 dogs is permitted before kennel regulations and zoning by-laws apply.
notes: URL: https://www.dysartetal.ca/en/municipal-government/resources/Documents/By-law-2020-45-Canine-Control.pdf. The municipality abolished its dog licensing and tagging program entirely in June 2020. The current Canine Control By-law governs dog behaviour but has no specific exemptions for farm dogs or LGDs.

lgd_definition: “Working/Livestock Guardian Dog” means a Dog that is specifically trained to work and/or live with domestic farm Animals (ie. cattle, sheep, goats, etc.) without causing them harm while aggressively repelling predators;
collar_tag_req: Every Owner or Person in Control of, or in apparent Control of, a Dog shall Keep the Tag securely fixed on the Dog at all times (except while the dog is being used for hunting purposes or when a Working/Livestock Guardian Dog is actively engaged in their duties).
dog_limit: No Person shall Keep more than three (3) Dogs in any Dwelling Unit or any other structure used for commercial, industrial, or institutional purposes within the Town.
notes: URL: https://www.eastgwillimbury.ca/en/By-law-and-Parking/Animal-Care-and-Control-By-law-2020-085-and-admendment.pdf. Highly farm-friendly bylaw. It explicitly exempts Working/Livestock Guardian Dogs from wearing a collar/tag while actively engaged in their duties to prevent snagging or injury. Agricultural buildings are also implicitly exempt from the 3-dog limit. The municipality's fee schedule offers a flat-rate 'Working/Livestock Guardian Dog Licence' per farm.

collar_tag_req: Failing to keep a dog tag securely fixed to a dog is an offence.
dog_limit: Owning, operating, managing, controlling or supervising an unlicensed kennel is prohibited.
notes: URL: https://www.eastgarafraxa.ca/media/2v3flm3v/32-2005-license-dogs.pdf. The complete text of By-Law 2-95 is not available online, only subsequent amendments. However, the township's separate Noise By-Law 43-2004 explicitly exempts 'noise or sounds normally associated with an agricultural operation, including the operation of farm machinery, animals, livestock, etc.' from barking and noise restrictions.

lgd_definition: “Livestock Guardian Dog” means a Dog that works and/or lives with Livestock to protect them while repelling predators and is used exclusively for that purpose.
herding_definition: “Herding Dog” means a Dog that has been trained and is actively being used in an agricultural operation for the purposes of controlling Livestock on the farm;
collar_tag_req: The Owner shall securely affix the dog tag to the Dog's Collar so that it will remain with the Dog at all times during the year, except for Livestock Guardian Dogs and Herding Dogs.
dog_limit: No person shall keep more than three (3) dogs at any one time without providing proof that the Persons abutting the property on all sides of the Property where the Dogs are being kept consent to the keeping of more than three (3) dogs, or without a Kennel Licence.
notes: URL: https://www.essex.ca/media/i3ac4jym/by-law-no-1966-animal-control-signed.pdf. Very farm-friendly bylaw. It clearly defines both Livestock Guardian Dogs and Herding Dogs, explicitly exempts both from wearing a dog tag, and their licensing program lists the fee for both as 'No charge'. Furthermore, the Town's Noise By-law (2422) exempts persistent noise making by any animal kept or used for agricultural purposes.

lgd_definition: “Working Dog” shall include sheep dogs and mean a dog trained to aid in herding or protecting sheep and is actually being used for that purpose.
herding_definition: “Working Dog” shall include sheep dogs and mean a dog trained to aid in herding or protecting sheep and is actually being used for that purpose.
collar_tag_req: The dog tag shall be kept securely fixed on the dog at all times until the tag is renewed or replaced. This tag may be removed when the dog is being lawfully used for herding or protecting sheep on public or private lands.
dog_limit: Not more than a total of four (4) dogs shall be kept in or about any dwelling unit in an urban area.
notes: URL: https://s3.ca-central-1.amazonaws.com/gananoque.ca/s3fs-public/By-law%20No.%202010-03-Animal%20Control-Consolidated-07Jun2011_0.pdf. Farm friendly because it defines 'Working Dog' to include protecting and herding sheep, and uniquely allows them to have their tags removed when actively working on public or private lands. The 4-dog limit also explicitly only applies to an 'urban area'.

collar_tag_req: Every owner or person in control of, or in apparent control of, a registered dog shall keep the dog tag securely fixed on the animal at all times (except while the dog is being used for hunting purposes).
dog_limit: No owner(s) or tenant(s) within any residential, commercial, industrial, or institutional zoned property in the Town of Georgina shall keep more than three dogs per property.
notes: URL: https://www.georgina.ca/sites/default/files/2026-03/bylaw-2004-0130-li-3.pdf. The bylaw does not explicitly define farm dogs, but its 3-dog limit specifically only applies to residential, commercial, industrial, or institutional zones, effectively exempting agricultural and rural zoned properties from the dog limit.

collar_tag_req: Dog owners must purchase lifetime dog licenses for all dogs in their ownership once the dog is 12 weeks of age or older.
dog_limit: No person shall keep no more than three (3) dogs at anyone time on one property. This excludes the communities of Port Severn, Honey Harbour and MacTier, which only allow two (2) dogs to be kept on one property.
notes: URL: https://www.gbtownship.ca/township-hall/animal-control/. Modernized animal control bylaw enforcing lifetime dog tags. While no specific exemptions for agricultural properties or farm dogs were found in the animal control regulations, the Township's Noise By-law 2022-030 explicitly exempts 'normal farming practices' from noise restrictions.

lgd_definition: "Farm Livestock Guardian Dog - shall mean a Dog which is actively guarding or herding farm animals, such as cattle or sheep, and such Dog is under the control of its Owner, who shall be a registered member of Ontario Federation of Agriculture or Christian Farmers Federation of Ontario;"
collar_tag_req: Every dog must be licensed and bear a serial number tag.
dog_limit: The bylaw restricts keeping more than two (2) Dogs on a property, provided that this section does not apply unless the dwelling unit is located on land zoned agricultural or has a kennel license.
notes: URL: https://www.townofgrandvalley.ca/media/xk5n4mcq/2014-46-consolidated-2022.pdf. Highly farm-friendly bylaw. It explicitly defines 'Farm Livestock Guardian Dog' (noting OFA or CFFO membership) and exempts them from 'running at large' provisions while actively engaged in their trained duties. The town's Fees and Charges By-law lists 'Livestock Guardian' tags as 'No charge', and agriculturally zoned properties are exempt from the 2-dog limit.

collar_tag_req: Every person who keeps a dog shall obtain a dog licence tag and ensure it is affixed to the dog.
dog_limit: No more than three dogs over the age of 10 weeks can be kept on any premises unless grandfathered under the By-law or licensed as a Kennel.
notes: URL: https://www.grimsby.ca/media/fflmg41o/to-regulate-animal-care-and-control-in-the-town-of-grimsby-by-law-no-10-06-final.pdf. A standard animal control bylaw with no specific provisions, definitions, or exemptions for LGDs or working farm dogs. However, the Grimsby Noise By-law 11-22 exempts noises emitted in connection with normal agricultural operations.
